FerryWellCo is an Amsterdam team bringing environmental research into outdoor planning. GOTime is a planning layer for outdoor activity apps. Its interactive example compares heat and air-quality conditions for a planned run with another available time, using illustrative values. Start at the [homepage](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/) or the [GOTime page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/gotime/).

The [GOTime page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/gotime/) describes potential placements and a focused pilot. The [science page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/science/) covers air pollution, heat and pollen. The [about page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/about/) introduces the team. The [privacy page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/privacy/) describes the email contact form.
